title: A forbidden-induced-subgraph characterization of beautiful graphs
summary: A graph is beautiful if each of its induced subgraphs is the intersection graph of all maximal nonempty 1-rectangles of a binary matrix, with adjacency defined by a common cell. Beautiful graphs were introduced as a hereditary class of Berge graphs, but a complete forbidden-induced-subgraph characterization was not obtained. We prove that a finite graph is beautiful if and only if it has no induced $C_4$, gem, net, watch, or odd hole.
